title: Nested `<Frame>` inside a `clientEntry` re-resolves target-less on a non-root ancestor reload
author: markmals
body_preview: Reloading a non-root ancestor frame (e.g. navigating an intermediate `detail` frame) re-resolves a nested non-blocking `<Frame>` that lives inside a `clientEntry` on the _client_, target-less; the server-streamed content for it is thrown away and the no-target response is shown instead. title: Fragment-nested `<Frame>` doesn't adopt its hydration marker
author: markmals
body_preview: A `<Frame>` that is the first child of a bare `<Fragment>` (`<>`) returned by a `clientEntry` fails to adopt its server-rendered frame markers during hydration. It takes the fresh-insert path instead, duplicating the streamed subtree and re-fetching `src` on the client. Wrapping the same `<Frame>` in a host element (e.g. `<div>`) makes it hydrate cleanly. title: Client-mounted `<Frame>` resolves without its `target`
author: markmals
body_preview: When a named `<Frame>` is first resolved on the client (the fresh-insert path — e.g. a frame mounted after hydration), the runtime calls the user `resolveFrame` hook without the frame's name as the `target` argument.
